• Described by de Pinna, 1988
  • IUCN Red List: Critically Endangered (assessed 2018)

South America: marsh that is the source of a creek later joining Imbariê Creek, tributary of the Estrela River, Piabetá, Rio de Janeiro, and similar habitats in Picinguaba, São Paulo, Brazil.

Type locality: marsh which is source of creek later joining Ribeirão Imbariê, tributary of Rio Estrela, Localidade de Piabetá, Brazil.
Breeding: unreported. There is no breeding report.
Revue Suisse de Zoologie v. 95 (no. 1), pp 115, Figs. 1-2.
